headline: Global markets decline as AI regulation concerns trigger sell-off
summary: Global stock markets experienced a significant sell-off, with investors reacting to expectations of new US congressional regulations targeting artificial intelligence. The ASX 200 index saw a modest decline of 0.49% despite broader regional market volatility.
why: Artificial intelligence has been a primary driver of global equity market gains in recent years; regulatory uncertainty creates risks for the high valuations of major technology firms.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: Regulatory concerns regarding AI have led to a broad-based sell-off in technology-heavy indices.
